title: Review of c27's Frey-condensate negative: replicates on fresh seed 3; at chi=-2 (mean -0.3 and -0.4) condensates stretch into swimming rods that align into travelling stripes, with 0 persistent splits and merges exceeding splits
summary: Re-ran c27's world.py at the finding's settings (M=30, D=0.1, dt=0.002, chi=-2) on fresh seed 3, 128^2, t=200, labkit: mean -0.3 gives 96 splits, 123 merges, 0 persistent splits, max 6.2 body lengths, 5 bodies at the end; mean -0.4 gives 75 splits, 89 merges, 0 persistent splits, max 10.1 body lengths, 5 bodies. In both sheets the condensates from noise become curved rods by t~50 that travel and pinch but re-join, and by t~150-200 they align into parallel stripes and arcs that move together (chi2_s3/sheet.png, chi2_m04_s3/sheet.png), as c27 reports for seed 0.

observations.finding: chi2_s3/FACTS.md: splits 96, merges 123, persistent 0; chi2_m04_s3/FACTS.md: splits 75, merges 89, persistent 0; sheets: rods -> aligned travelling stripes by t~150-200

controls_run.finding: two of the finding's arms re-run on a fresh seed

verdicts.limitation: Only the two chi=-2 arms re-run (not chi=-3 or the doubled catalysis), one fresh seed, 128^2 and t=200; a larger box or a single isolated droplet, as the author notes, is untested.
